assure.objective: Keep candidates inside an authoritative rule set and improve the rules from independent outcomes.

stageActivities.sense: Load the applicable setpoint and observe the candidate.
stageActivities.judge: Compare the candidate with every applicable rule and preserve indeterminacy.
stageActivities.act: Block, allow, or hand off according to the judgment.
stageActivities.verify: Observe independent downstream outcomes after the decision.
stageActivities.learnOrEscalate: Revise an ineffective rule or escalate an unresolved evidence gap.

reconcile.objective: Reduce a measurable difference between declared desired state and independently observed actual state.

stageActivities.sense: Read declared desired state and independently observe actual state.
stageActivities.judge: Classify the delta without treating an unreadable observation as agreement.
stageActivities.act: Correct the delta or hand it to the declared authority.
stageActivities.learnOrEscalate: Close on the setpoint, revise a faulty declaration, or escalate a persistent delta.

fulfill.objective: Make an accepted intent real and close only when its actual outcome has been observed.

stageActivities.sense: Receive an intent and the observations needed to evaluate its preconditions.
stageActivities.judge: Validate the intent, authority, budget, and guardrails.
stageActivities.act: Materialize the authorized intent through the configured mechanism.
stageActivities.verify: Observe the actual outcome rather than provider acceptance alone.
stageActivities.learnOrEscalate: Retry, compensate, adjust, or escalate when the outcome misses its setpoint.

interact.objective: Handle a person or actor request with authorization, read-back, and reconciliation of later change or withdrawal.

stageActivities.sense: Receive the request and current standing instructions.
stageActivities.judge: Authorize the request and confirm the intended meaning.
stageActivities.act: Fulfil, refuse, or hand off the confirmed intent.
stageActivities.verify: Read the interpretation or outcome back to the subject.
stageActivities.learnOrEscalate: Reconcile change or withdrawal, or escalate an unresolved request.

steward.objective: Keep custody accountable from inventory through justified protection, correction, disposal, and verification.

stageActivities.sense: Inventory the held resource and its provenance, owner, and lifecycle state.
stageActivities.judge: Evaluate whether custody remains justified, current, and inside policy.
stageActivities.act: Protect, correct, rotate, disclose, revoke, or dispose as authorized.
stageActivities.verify: Observe the resulting custody or disposal state independently.
stageActivities.learnOrEscalate: Update the lifecycle rule or escalate an unresolved custody gap.

optimize.objective: Learn from independent signals by measuring, reporting, adjusting, and measuring again.

stageActivities.sense: Collect independent signals for the declared question and coverage.
stageActivities.judge: Normalize the signals and compare the metric with its setpoint.
stageActivities.act: Report the measured result and propose the bounded adjustment.
stageActivities.verify: Measure again after the adjustment using the declared evidence source.
stageActivities.learnOrEscalate: Update the model or escalate a persistent blind spot or miss.

qualificationVerdicts.create: Create a role package only when the charter is complete and no current role owns and closes its metric loop.
qualificationVerdicts.extend: Extend one current role when that role already owns and closes the candidate's same job and metric loop.
qualificationVerdicts.compose: Compose current roles when two or more existing roles collectively already own and close the candidate's same job and metric loop.
qualificationVerdicts.reject: Reject a candidate that has no coherent job, one controllable metric, closed loop, durable boundary, or acceptable guardrails.

@vespeneventures/advisor.jobQuestion: Does each active engagement have a current, evidence-backed, authority-bound next decision or action?
@vespeneventures/advisor.closeCondition: Independent consumer evidence shows the position's owned metric meets its setpoint over the declared review cadence.

metric.name: engagement decision currency rate
metric.formula: active engagements whose assessment basis is fresh, whose next required action has an accountable owner and due date, and whose execution authorization if any matches the exact plan and basis / active engagements evaluated

boundary.owns: Normalized engagement state, sponsor dialogue, offering-fit/readiness/blocker/collision reconciliation, bounded recommendations, and required-next-action issuance.
excludes: granting authority or deciding consumer entitlement
installing packages or changing live state

@vespeneventures/controller.jobQuestion: Are the business's operating rules expressible, current, and followed?
@vespeneventures/controller.closeCondition: Independent consumer evidence shows the position's owned metric meets its setpoint over the declared review cadence.

metric.name: rule conformance rate
metric.formula: declared rules independently observed well-formed and followed / all declared rules evaluated

boundary.owns: Operating-rule grammar, identity, lifecycle, and content binding.
